# awdiscord

> Put any agent on Discord as a real bot, with an operator in the loop.

Putting an agent in a Discord server usually means one of two bad shapes: a script driving a person's account, which breaks Discord's terms and gets the account banned, or a bot that answers anyone as fast as they can type and acts on its own judgement. What is missing is the boring middle: an install link that asks for almost nothing, per-user and per-server limits, and a way for the agent to ask a human before it does something, with an answer it can trust.

## Install

```
pip install git+https://github.com/Aitherium/awdiscord.git
```

## Use it in 30 seconds

Put an agent you already run into your Discord server as a bot with /ask.

## Composes with

- [awdk](https://aitherium.github.io/awdk/) — Build AI agent fleets — 3 lines, any backend, local or cloud.
- [awask](https://aitherium.github.io/awask/) — Your agent asks you a question — and acts on your answer.
- [awrelay](https://aitherium.github.io/awrelay/) — Portable agent messaging — findings, alerts, coordination.
- [awmail](https://aitherium.github.io/awmail/) — Give an agent an email address — send, and actually receive.
- [awiam](https://aitherium.github.io/awiam/) — Who is this caller? A directory and session store that fails honestly.
